root_text:
🤧 Know the Facts, Protect Your Health! 🛡️
Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) is a respiratory virus that can affect anyone, especially young children, older adults, and those with weakened immune systems.

Stay informed, stay safe! 🌟

#HMPV #huma
